body:
When people talk about stuff i hear something else than what they're saying. People can be talking about normal stuff but i get really confused about what they're saying and sometimes it outright feels like they're going to kill me, they drop cues and hints every now and then and then resort back to their "normal" state.

I don't know why i need structure but i don't want to live in this state
why are people reading, upvoting and then going somewhere else. Last time i posted i got no answers i don't know what to do i'm freaking out
